sections.notes: Legacy single grid rebuilt. LEGAL ERROR FIXED: the tool gave the claw-back look-backs as 'transaction at undervalue - 5-year look-back for associates; 2 years for others'. sections.title: Inheritance Tax and Income Tax and Capital Gains Tax for an Estate
sections.notes: The carry-forward item from 20 Aug 2026, and the longest chapter in WILL13. Was a 3,754-character stub with 250 default words and no statutes entries. STALE CONTENT CORRECTED: NRB/RNRB frozen to APRIL 2031, not 2028; the spouse exemption and scope now run on LONG-TERM UK RESIDENCE for deaths from 6 April 2025 (10 of the last 20 tax years, with a 3-to-10-year tail), not domicile - domicile survives only for the GBP 325,000 cap on gifts to a non-dom spouse; BPR is renamed BUSINESS RELIEF per the Business update at 7.20, and business and agricultural relief now share a COMBINED GBP 2.5m cap on 100% relief from 6 April 2026 with 50% above, transferable between spouses to GBP 5m; PR CGT is 24% for ALL assets from 6 April 2026 (32% carried interest), not 20%/24%; dividends for PRs at 10.75% from 2026/2027. FACTUAL ERROR FIXED: the tool said the PR annual exempt amount is NIL in years after death. It runs for the year of death AND THE NEXT TWO TAX YEARS. Marriage exemption figures corrected to parent 5,000 / grandparent 2,500 / between the parties 2,500 / others 1,000. ADDED: IHTA 1984 s 10 arm's length and s 11 family maintenance; loss to donor and related property; the 20%/25% CLT split and grossing up; the quarter-up rule for quoted shares; quick-succession relief with its formula; post-mortem relief (12 months for shares, 3 years for land plus fourth-year losses); woodlands relief; the RNRB taper, brought-forward allowance and downsizing addition; gifts with reservation, double charges relief and pre-owned asset tax; the payment/liability/burden table and the instalment option; and the estate reporting thresholds. Also flagged the April 2027 change bringing unused discretionary pension pots into the estate. 15 statutes entries where there were none. Section object is 42.8k characters, above the 12-20k guidance, but the chapter runs to roughly 25 manual pages and everything beyond the overview map, two genuine forks and a six-line spine note sits in collapsed panels.
